areas.name: Environmental sustainability, adaptation and mitigation
areas.reason: Revitalisation of vulnerable degraded areas, flood reduction through nature-based drainage and institutional strengthening for risk management.

areas.name: Basic sanitation
areas.reason: Sanitation is an integral action, with sewer collection networks across the city.

areas.name: Integrated water-resources management and water security
areas.reason: Integrated actions on risk management, drainage, water resilience and vulnerability reduction address water-security deficits.

areas.name: Jobs and income for low-income and vulnerable groups
areas.reason: Tender clauses require a minimum share of local labour and social work provides job-oriented training.

areas.name: Infrastructure and social facilities for low-income and vulnerable groups
areas.reason: Territorial development components (sanitation, paving, housing, rent support, social work) directly benefit low-income residents of flood areas.

areas.name: Youth, gender and race policies
areas.reason: Resettlement prioritises low-income women, female-headed households and women under protective measures; women's consent required and domestic-violence safeguards.

areas.name: Public-service delivery, management and citizen participation
areas.reason: Disaster and climate emergency control centre, staff training, public alert application and AI-assisted geomonitoring.

areas.name: Energy efficiency and renewable energy
areas.reason: Only minor efficiency elements (pumping station, sustainable buildings); no direct energy efficiency or renewable actions.

areas.name: Biodiversity and forest resources
areas.reason: Ecological corridors from watercourse requalification are mentioned, but no direct biodiversity or forest management actions.

areas.name: Business environment and opportunities
areas.reason: No direct action to improve the business environment.

areas.name: Individual entrepreneurs and micro/small firms
areas.reason: Private-sector participation, microcredit and partnerships are planned intentions, not accepted as direct benefits for small firms.

areas.name: Inclusion of social minorities
areas.reason: No direct action on inclusion of minorities among beneficiaries.

areas.name: Education and health conditions
areas.reason: Only indirect health and quality-of-life effects; no direct education or health actions.

areas.name: Technological development, innovation and modernization
areas.reason: Program does not directly address technological development or modernisation.

areas.name: Financing arrangements encouraging private participation
areas.reason: No financing arrangements such as PPPs were directly verified.
